_notes: All canticles are Vulgate OT canticles (Habakkuk, Wisdom, Jeremiah, Isaiah) used at Lauds. Habakkuk 3 (Hab 3:1-6, Hab 3:2-33) and its sub-portions (Ibid. v.13-19, v.7-12) follow the Vulgate, which diverges substantially from Hebrew/CUV (e.g. 'Deo Iesu meo' / 救我的神耶稣 in 3:31/3:18 reflects the Septuagint reading; rendered literally). 'Ibid. 10:17-21' is the Canticle of Wisdom (Sap/智慧篇 10:17-21), deuterocanon, fetched from 思高 (ccreadbible Studium). The trailing 'Ibid.' headings refer to the same book as the immediately preceding canticle (Habakkuk), rendered 同上. CUV wording adapted to Latin verse-by-verse * split points; where Vulgate has content CUV omits, translated from Latin in matching register. Habakkuk numbering: Vulgate Hab 3 = Hebrew Hab 3 (no psalm offset, prophetic book). 'Hab 3:2-33' uses the breviary's own continuous verse numbering.
